stage: Stage 24B — preregistered weakly supervised MIL development experiment

data.representation: SUMMARY_17 in exact frozen Stage 14 order
data.standardization: Feature-wise mean and population standard deviation fitted on all DEV_TRAIN instances only; apply unchanged to DEV_VAL; replace zero scales with 1

architecture.initialization: Xavier uniform linear weights; zero linear biases

batching.method: batch-local padding with boolean valid-instance masks
batching.attention_normalization: masked softmax over valid instances only

training.seed_note: The Stage 24B authorization explicitly replaces the Stage 24A draft seed list before training; no outcome was observed before this seal
training.determinism: Seed Python, NumPy, and PyTorch; deterministic algorithms enabled

primary_evaluation.arm_selection_rule: Highest five-seed mean average precision, then highest five-seed mean ROC_AUC; never select a seed

paired_bootstrap.comparison_probability: five-seed mean probability versus committed FULL_48 HGB probability

outcome_gates.A: Mean deltas >= +0.010 ROC_AUC and +0.020 AP, at least 4/5 seeds positive on both, and paired seed-ensemble bootstrap intervals above zero for both
outcome_gates.B: Mean deltas >= -0.010 ROC_AUC and -0.020 AP, at least 4/5 seeds meet both margins, plus reproducible concentration, top-removal greater than random with paired interval above zero, and relevance stability above matched random expectation
outcome_gates.C: Neither A nor B, or relevance is no more stable/informative than its controls

attention_analysis.matched_random_jaccard: Exact hypergeometric expectation for two independent size-k subsets of a size-m bag

perturbation.population: Every DEV_VAL bag with at least two instances
perturbation.metric: baseline customer probability minus post-removal customer probability; positive means removal lowers the prediction

trivial_controls.feature_associations: Spearman attention association with each frozen SUMMARY_17 feature, overall and by customer class
trivial_controls.padding_test: For eight fixed DEV_VAL bags per run, append seven masked zero rows; maximum absolute logit change tolerance 1e-7
trivial_controls.attention_test: Valid attention sums within 1e-6 of 1 and padded attention is exactly 0

allowed: predictive evidence used by the model
